answer.summary: A new, narrow research question is proposed to investigate explicitly stated temporal memory mechanisms in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 beyond decay and retention models.
answer.content: Propose a research question that identifies whether Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 reports any explicitly defined, time-bound memory mechanisms such as state transitions or conditional update triggers under known perturbations, with direct textual or mathematical evidence; if present, define the minimum duration of input required to observe a detectable shift in agent state due to those mechanisms alone. This focuses exclusively on verifiably reported dynamics without extrapolation or assumption.
answer.nextTask: handoff to analyst to extract and verify explicitly reported conditional state transitions or update triggers in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 under known perturbations; if any exist, define the minimum duration of periodic input required to observe a detectable state shift using only those triggers as anchors
answer.lesson: Memory research must anchor exclusively in explicitly reported, verifiable mechanisms to avoid speculative or ungrounded inferences from absent data structures or metadata claims.
